name: hdl-row-only-not-total
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Cholesterol, HDL, P*     52                 08/13/2026
note: Epic names the HDL row 'Cholesterol, HDL' - the leading word 'Cholesterol' must not satisfy a TOTAL cholesterol scan. With no total row present, total_c stays blank.

name: ldl-row-only-not-total
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Cholesterol, LDL, Calc     130                08/13/2026
note: Same trap for the calculated-LDL row: 130 is the LDL, and total_c must stay blank.

name: hdl-row-before-total-row
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Cholesterol, HDL, P*     52
Cholesterol, Total,*     197
note: When the HDL row is printed first, the scan must skip past it to the real total row rather than taking 52.

name: non-hdl-row-before-total
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Cholesterol, Non-HDL     145
Cholesterol, Total,*     197
Cholesterol, HDL, P*     52
note: Non-HDL is a distinct analyte; the total is 197.

name: no-results-for-chol-then-hdl
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
No results found for: CHOL
Cholesterol, HDL, P*     52
note: An empty-result line plus an HDL row must not produce a total cholesterol of 52.

name: slash-delimited-lipids-still-parse
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Chol 210 / HDL 45 / LDL 130
eGFR: 80
note: Slash-delimited values on one line: the guard against ratio names must not block these.

name: chol-hdl-ratio-not-a-value
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Chol/HDL ratio: 4.2
LDL / HDL: 2.6
Total chol: 210
HDL: 50
LDL: 130
note: Ratio lines are not analyte values; the real labeled values win.

name: creatinine-si-table-refrange
text:
Age: 60
Sex: Female
Component            Value     Ref Range          Status
Creatinine           97        44 - 106 umol/L    Final
note: SI creatinine result row: 97 umol/L is the result and 44-106 is the reference range. eGFR must be computed from 97, never from the range's high bound.

name: creatinine-si-tab-row-refrange
text:
Age: 60
Sex: Female
Creatinine	97	44 - 106 umol/L	Final
note: Tab-separated variant of the same row - the reference-range bound 106 would give a confidently wrong eGFR of 52.

name: creatinine-si-flagged-high
text:
Age: 60
Sex: Female
Creatinine           130 (H)   44 - 106 umol/L    Final
note: An (H) flag between the value and the range must not change which number is read.

name: creatinine-si-unit-in-label
text:
Age: 55
Sex: Male
Creatinine (umol/L): 88
note: The unit lives inside the label parenthetical; the value 88 is still umol/L.

name: uacr-umol-ratio-not-a-creatinine
text:
Age: 58
Sex: F
Albumin/Creatinine Ratio 12 umol/mmol
note: An albumin/creatinine ratio line is not a serum creatinine; reading 12 as one produced a bogus eGFR of 149.

name: creatinine-mgdl-regression
text:
Age: 58
Sex: F
Creatinine 1.1 mg/dL
note: Ordinary mg/dL creatinine still computes.

name: stated-egfr-beats-creatinine
text:
Age: 58
Sex: F
eGFR 74
Creatinine 88 umol/L
note: A stated eGFR is used directly; the creatinine fallback only fires when none is stated.

name: creatinine-during-aki-left-blank
text:
Age: 74
Sex: Male
Hospital day 2.
Cr 2.1 (baseline 1.1)
note: A creatinine drawn during AKI and annotated with a baseline is not the chronic value PREVENT needs, so eGFR stays blank for the clinician.

name: european-decimal-comma-lipids
text:
Age: 58
Sex: Female
Cholesterol total   5,4 mmol/L
HDL-cholesterol     1,3 mmol/L
LDL-cholesterol     3,2 mmol/L
note: A European decimal comma must not truncate 5,4 to 5 - that is a wrong number that still computes. Gated on the SI unit being present.

name: us-thousands-comma-untouched
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
UACR 1,234 mg/g
Total chol 197
HDL 45
note: A US thousands separator is not a decimal comma; UACR is 1234.

name: epic-comma-label-untouched
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Cholesterol, Total,*  197
Cholesterol, HDL, P*  37
note: Commas inside Epic lab names are punctuation, not decimal separators.

name: mmol-panel-reports-unit
text:
Age: 58
Sex: F
Total cholesterol: 5.4 mmol/L
HDL: 1.3 mmol/L
note: An SI panel is reported as mmol/L so the page can flip its unit toggle; both parsers must agree at SI magnitudes.

name: unitless-small-cholesterol-stays-blank
text:
Age: 58
Sex: F
Cholesterol: 5.4
HDL: 45
note: A small magnitude with no unit printed is ambiguous, so it stays blank rather than being guessed as mmol/L.

name: a1c-parenthetical-no-bleed-to-med-dose
text:
Age: 57
Sex: Female
PMH: HTN; DM ruled out 2024 (A1c 5.6); hypothyroidism
Meds: levothyroxine 75 mcg, amlodipine 5 mg
note: An A1c mentioned only inside a parenthetical must not let the scan fall onto the medication line below and read a 5 mg dose as an A1c of 5.

name: a1c-epic-result-table-still-parses
text:
Age: 74
Sex: male
A1c: Hemoglobin A1c
     Date                     Value               Ref Range           Status
     08/20/2026               5.1                 4.3 - 5.6 %         Final
note: The real Epic A1c result table still parses: 5.1 is the result, 4.3-5.6 the reference range.
